title: 2026 budget timelines approved at special meeting
subtitle: Council calendar deferred to November 10; in-camera settlement authorized for unexpected costs at a City facility.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on October 27, 2025, chaired by Acting Mayor P. Singh. The Mayor and Councillor B. Ioannidis were absent. Council approved the 2026 budget timelines in report FIN-2025-408 {{vote:m1}}. It also shortened the 30-day period in which Council may amend the Mayor's proposed budget, so that period ends with the December 11, 2025 meeting. This sets the schedule for when residents and Council can expect budget decisions to be finalized.

Council deferred the 2026 Council and Committee Calendar to the November 10, 2025 meeting {{vote:m2}}. The calendar was to include extra Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee meetings to meet Planning Act deadlines. Meeting dates for 2026 are therefore not yet confirmed.

After a closed session on a legal matter involving a commercial lease, Council authorized the Chief Administrative Officer to sign a settlement agreement and approve payments {{vote:m4}}. The settlement covers unexpected costs at a City facility. The minutes do not make the particulars public. The meeting adjourned at 5:38 p.m.

decisions.detail: Council approved the 2026 budget timelines in report FIN-2025-408 and shortened the 30-day window for amending the Mayor's proposed budget to end with the December 11, 2025 meeting.
Council deferred approval of the 2026 calendar, including delegated authority to schedule extra planning committee meetings, to the November 10, 2025 Council meeting.
Council authorized the Chief Administrative Officer to execute a settlement agreement and approve payments to fully settle unexpected costs related to a City facility, as discussed in closed session.
